prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: definitive full-body character master for heyNag, an original personal brand.
Input image: existing selected curious moth, used as continuity reference. REDESIGN its anatomy deliberately as specified, not a palette-only change.
Primary request: one appealing original moth companion that reflects a person who is fun, talkative, curious, geeky and warmly witty. It should feel like an attentive creative peer with a mischievous spark. Contemporary polished 2D animation design, flat clear shapes, lively purposeful asymmetry. The current reference is too botanical and fluffy; improve recognition, structure and acting.
Permanent signature: character LEFT / viewer RIGHT antenna stem is 1.6 times longer than the other, rising then gently reaching forward. Character RIGHT / viewer LEFT antenna is short and low/lateral. Both end in broad BLUNT ROUNDED PADDLES, absolutely not pointed leaves. Preserve clean negative space between stems. Antennae compact, together no more than28% of overall silhouette height. Maintain this left/right anatomy.
Head: broad warm cream rounded head, ONLY2 or3 broad cheek tufts per side, charcoal oval eyes spaced consistently, one soft raised brow, inviting small conversational half-smile. Face dominates, no tiny face under huge antennae. No baby cheeks, no blush.
Body: compact cream torso, shallow THREE-lobed collar immediately below head. EXACTLY TWO short arms attached to torso sides BELOW collar, clear mitten hands with a single thumb notch. Arms distinct from collar, never merged with cheeks. Arms in front of wings. Two short rounded chartreuse feet.
Wings: soft folded wing cape behind torso, broader high at the shoulders then tapering below, clean broad gently scalloped lower edge. One flat chartreuse green fill per wing; no leaf-shaped dangling wings, no teardrop marks, no veins or decorative spots. It should read as a little cape when resting. Character is still unmistakably a friendly stylized moth, not a plant or a bunny.
Pose: grounded slight three-quarter stance, long antenna notices something first just to the viewer's right, head subtly follows while face stays open to visitor. One hand loosely open in conversational explanation, other relaxed. An attentive amused expression, not a permanently ecstatic grin or stern concentration.
Palette: charcoal #1C1C1C contour/eyes, warm cream #FFF5DF face/body, signature chartreuse #A8C84B wings/antenna tips/feet. Clean solid flat opaque internal fills, crisp confidently even contour, no gradients or texture.
Composition: exactly ONE complete character, centered in square canvas with8%outer margin, full antenna tips/wings/feet visible, genuinely transparent alpha background. No backdrop, ground shadow, glow or haze. No glasses in this master; a separate deep-work pose will add glasses later. No props, clothing, text, motion strokes, symbols, logo, watermark. Do not imitate any existing character. Final art should support120px full-body use and a future tighter32px head avatar.
role: Historical V2 study, superseded by V5. Retained for provenance and earlier prototypes; do not use as the current model.
review: Character and brand Astra reviews recommended asymmetric antennae, distinct hands and collar, cape wings, singular chartreuse identity.
invariants: Viewer-right antenna permanently longer; viewer-left short and lateral
Warm cream face and body, charcoal contours
Three-lobed collar, two arms clearly below it
Chartreuse cape-like wings with no leaf teardrops
